checkedAlternates.risk: Frame narratives often use a first-person narrator.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Frame narrative describes a story-within-a-story structural device (group-4), not a grammatical person perspective (group-2).
Second-person addresses the protagonist as "you" (group-1), distinct from "I/we" first-person narration (group-2).
